name: Ultralight Walnut Slats, Black Felt
summary: Real walnut veneer laminated directly onto 9 mm recycled acoustic felt, with a black felt backing and no MDF or other rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec overrides photo estimates: 7 slats, 1.20 in faces + 0.49 in grooves = 1.69 in pitch; 90-degree V-grooves cut 6.2 mm into 9 mm felt (2.8 mm backbone), real walnut veneer with no rigid core, and 0.35 in total depth. Tile spans 7 pitches by 23.66 in, preserving face/groove sizes despite the rounded 11.80 in panel width (7 pitches total 11.83 in); muted walnut color is sampled from the main photo, with charcoal-black felt and procedural seamless grain.
